From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment items

Alex — great questions. Short answers up top, details/next steps below.

• API keys: yes — we issue org-scoped API keys tied to a customer org. Keys can be rotated independently and we support IP-based allowlisting on the key level. For the MAP we recommend a short-lived key pair for initial smoke tests and then move to a longer-lived key bound to your org for the evaluation stage.

• IP ranges & ports: see attachment 'vpc-peering-requirements.docx' for the canonical list, but the minimum set for initial allowlist is:
  - Control plane (APIs/backplane callbacks): 34.200.128.0/20 (TCP 443)
  - Inference egress (worker outbound): 52.62.0.0/18 (TCP 443)
  - Management (DNS/metrics): 54.152.0.0/19 (TCP 53/UDP 53, TCP 443)

We also support peering (preferred) or secure egress via NAT when peering isn't possible. Peering requires a one-time ASN exchange and the following items from Aurora: VPC ID, CIDR, and contact for peering request.

Proposed runbook (we'll add to the MAP PDF v1 attached):
  1) By Jul 2 — Aurora provides VPC ID/CIDR + primary network contact and confirms internal approvals.
  2) Jul 3–5 — Redwood creates Aurora org and issues bootstrap API key (scoped, IP-restricted if requested).
  3) Jul 6 — Network dry-run: exchange peering request and validate routes.
  4) Jul 8 — Peering active or NAT egress validated; keys in place.
  5) Jul 12 — Smoke tests and basic inference checks.

Action items for us (Diego + Dylan): I asked Diego to draft the precise peering request template and Dylan to prepare the org creation checklist (IAM roles we create, default limits).

Let us know if the dates above look tight — we can slide by a few days but July 12 start is preferable for our capacity window.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v1.pdf, vpc-peering-requirements.docx

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment items

Priya — quick answers and I've attached a concise peering template as requested.

• Audit logs: we can provide a read-only audit export for the POC via a secured S3 bucket (monthly retention by default). For short POCs we can extend to 90 days on request; let us know if you need longer. Exports include control plane calls (org creation, key issuance, role changes) and admin API events.

• Bootstrap key rotation: default short-lived bootstrap keys are 72-hour TTL and can be rotated via our Admin API. We'll include the rotation sample in the org checklist. For the longer-lived evaluation key we recommend a 30-day rotation cadence (customer-driven).

• One-line peering flow for your networking lead (copy into ticket): 
  "Aurora creates VPC peering request -> Redwood accepts peering -> Exchange route propagation; test reachability on TCP/443 -> Close ticket."

Action: I uploaded a 1-page peering template (aurora-network-diagram.png + vpc-peering-requirements.docx). Marissa — can we commit to org + bootstrap key by Jul 3 to honor Priya's earlier buffer request?

—Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

All — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming next steps and owners so we can close the MAP sprint: 

Owners & deadlines: 
  - Aurora (Alex/Priya): provide VPC ID, CIDR, and network contact by 2026-06-29 (Alex/Priya)
  - Redwood (Marissa): create Aurora org and issue bootstrap API key by 2026-07-03 (Marissa)
  - Redwood (Diego): submit peering acceptance & provide one-line template by 2026-07-05 (Diego)
  - Redwood (Dylan): deliver org checklist (IAM roles, initial quotas) by 2026-07-05 (Dylan)

Risks & mitigations: 
  - If peering cannot be established before Jul 8, we'll provide NAT-based secure egress and skip peering for the first smoke test. That will still allow tokenized inference calls and end-to-end logs.
  - Audit log retention extension requests (beyond 90 days) will require SOC/compliance review; flag early if needed.

I've attached the updated MAP PDF (Aurora_MAP_v1.pdf) with the runbook and timeline. We'll schedule a 30-minute handoff call on Jul 6 to validate peering dry-run status — Marissa will send the invite once we confirm the VPC ID.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
